title: 16684 - 16684/P0300/000768
commonCauses: Ignition Cable(s) and/or Spark Plug(s) faulty
EGR Gaz Devridaim Sistemi (EGR) Valve (N18) stuck/open
Eksantrik Konum Sensörü Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G40) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Air Emme System for leaks
Kontrol edin:  Fuel Supply (pressure, quality, delivery quantity)
Kontrol edin:  Injector(s) and Injector Sealing
Kontrol edin:  Ignition Cable(s) and Spark Plug(s)
Kontrol edin:  Engine Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G28)
Kontrol edin:  for Carbon buildup (compression Çok Yüksek (Aşırı Basınç))
Kontrol edin:  EGR Gaz Devridaim Sistemi (EGR) Valve (N18)
Kontrol edin:  Eksantrik Konum Sensörü Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G40)
technicalNotes:
This DTC indicates that one or multiple cylinders are misfiring, but the ECU fails to identify the cylinder.
See this Volkswagen Diagnostic Aid https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2022/MC-10214471-0001.pdf
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: 2008-2013 A3, TT and 2009-2013 A4, A5, Q5 and A6 vehicles with the 2,0l TFSI (EA888) engines it maybe necessary to Reset the Misfire Adaptions.
As per TSB [01 13 73] | TPI [2033223] - 01 Engine warning light on after engine replacement EA888 2.0 TFSI
To Reset Misfire Adaptions: Clear the 01-Engine fault codes three times in a row in less than 29 seconds "to remove the programed values."
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2014/MC-10124866-9999.pdf  NHTSA
For the Tiguan with the 2.0T DGUE engine that has one or more of the following fault codes, please see TSB 054615 for possible ECM update and hardware update.
P0172, P0300, P0301, P0302,P0303, P0304, P0441, P0456, P060C, P2440 and/or P2450
